snippet.title: Cateau - Swedish Game Awards Trailer
snippet.description:
Lemon Curd Games is proud to present the finalised version of Cateau!

Specially prepared for SGA, this refined version of the game contains more elaborate and fluid character reactions, an improved, more dynamic reading experience, along with many hours of polish to a myriad of other aspects. 


This game will be released to the public, stay tuned to find out when!

Keep up to date at:

https://www.lemoncurdgames.com/

https://www.facebook.com/LemonCurdGames/
